innovation is a key driver of economic growth and structural change, that innovation is the result of a process of collective learning that involves firms, users and institutions, that innovation is not only a supply side phenomenon, but it is also a demand driven phenomenon, that innovation is an endogenous process, but that it is not always self-sustained, that the impact of innovation on economic growth and structural changes is mediated by demand and distribution.

the innovation system approach has a great potential to contribute to a better understanding of innovation and economic change, and that the approach is not a panacea, but rather a research program that has to be developed in a number of directions, including the integration of demand, distribution, and macroeconomic dynamics, as well as the integration of micro and meso level dynamics.
